ov: Eight species of Australian lizards named for the spiny "beard" under the throat, which darkens and puffs up when they are stressed, threatened or courting. They live in deserts and shrublands and bask by day. The central bearded dragon is one of the most popular pet reptiles.

why.h: In cool weather they brumate, a hibernation-like state in which they go months without eating.
why.p: One of the most popular pet reptiles in the world, and the most kept reptile in the US in a 2021 study.

wt: Central bearded dragon: up to about 550 g
df: Central bearded dragon: in summer, about half plants and a quarter termites by volume.
fx: In one experiment, bearded dragons learned to open a door to reach food by watching another dragon do it.
They do not call, apart from a soft hiss; they talk with colour, posture, arm waves and head bobs.
